title: Luscious Crispy Mediterranean Lamb Wrap
description: A crispy and flavorful lamb wrap featuring pickle juice and nuka-pickle, wrapped in a lotus leaf wrap. This dish is a perfect flexitarian-friendly option for a rainy day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to the oven and roast for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the pickle juice and nuka-pickle.
Brush the pickle juice mixture onto the lamb during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Warm the lotus leaf wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the lamb and layering it with feta cheese, mixed greens, and a drizzle of the pickle juice mixture.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
